title: UpdateOutputRequest
description: Body of `PATCH /api/outputs/:id`. Both fields are optional — absent means unchanged. `config`, when present, is shallow-merged into the stored config: each top-level key in the patch replaces that key's stored value and absent keys are kept (HEL-1313 removed the former one-level deep merge of `legend`/`tooltip`/`seriesColors`/`axisLabels`; those are now unknown keys). The merge result is not validated as a whole: only keys this patch introduces or changes are checked against the Output kind's known keys.

config.description: Output config. `compare` (HEL-1273) selects the history comparison: absent/null (none), `previous_run`, `1d`, `7d`, `30d`, or `custom:<d>` where <d> is a positive ISO-8601 duration in days/hours/minutes/seconds (PnDTnHnMnS, at most 365 days; week/month/year and lowercase/signed forms are rejected). Anything else is a 400. `historyPayloads` (HEL-1276) opts this Output's node into storing each real run's full row payload (boolean, default off; absent/null/false store none): kept only for beta (10 runs / 7 days) and owner (30 runs / 30 days) pipeline owners, never for free, and a node over 1000 rows or 1 MiB stores none. Any non-boolean is a 400. Known top-level `config` keys per kind (HEL-1313; every other key is a 400 naming it, with a did-you-mean hint): every kind - `fieldMapping`, `compare`, `historyPayloads`; chart - `chartType`, `aggregation`, `chartOptions`, `annotation`, `referenceLines`, `referenceBands`; metric - `aggregation`, `label`, `unit`, `format`, `conditionalFormats`; table - `columnOrder`, `columnFormats`, `columnSort`, `columnFilters`, `pinnedColumns`, `conditionalFormats`; collection - `layout`, `format`, `conditionalFormats`; timeline - `sort`; markdown - `content`. A key already stored on the Output (a legacy key such as `metricLabel`) may be re-sent with its stored value unchanged, or cleared with null; introducing or changing any other unknown key is rejected, so `additionalProperties` is deliberately not false here. `aggregation` is null, `{groupBy, agg, yField}` on a chart (never on a scatter, heatmap or histogram chart), or `{agg}` (field from `fieldMapping.value`) / `{value, agg}` on a metric; `agg` is count|sum|avg|min|max and every named field a non-empty string; any other kind or shape is a 400. `chartType` is bar|line|pie|scatter|heatmap|histogram or null. `conditionalFormats` (HEL-1307; metric, table, collection) is null/[] or an ordered list (max 20, first match wins) of rules `{op, value, value2?, tone, label?, column?, target?}`: `op` is gt|gte|lt|lte|between (finite number `value`; between also `value2` >= `value`) or eq|neq (number or text `value`); `tone` is success|warning|error; `label` is optional text (1-60); a table rule needs `column` and may set `target` cell (default) or row; metric/collection rules take neither. Rules compare the raw value. An invalid list is a 400 naming the rule index. `chartOptions.histogram.binCount`, when written, is null/absent or a whole number from 2 to 100, else a 400 naming `binCount`; a heatmap reads Columns/Rows/Value from `fieldMapping` `xAxis`/`series`/`yAxis` and a histogram its numeric field from `xAxis`. `referenceLines` (HEL-1306) is null or at most 5 objects `{value, label?, tone?}` and `referenceBands` null or at most 3 objects `{from, to, label?, tone?}` with `from` less than `to`; `value`/`from`/`to` are finite numbers, `label` is 1 to 60 characters with at least one non-whitespace character, `tone` is neutral|success|warning|error (default neutral), no other item keys; a violation is a 400 naming the key and item index.

fieldMapping.description: Slot name -> column name; slot names are validated per kind.

aggregation.description: Chart or metric kind only; null clears it.

referenceLines.description: Chart only (bar, line, scatter, histogram): static horizontal reference lines on the value axis (the count axis on a histogram), at most 5. Not drawn on a pie, heatmap or 100% stacked bar (stored values are kept). `null` or `[]` clears.

referenceBands.description: Chart only (bar, line, scatter, histogram): static translucent bands on the value axis, at most 3; `from` must be less than `to` (a 400 otherwise; JSON Schema cannot express it). `null` or `[]` clears.

format.description: Metric and collection kinds. One of number, integer, currency, percent, duration, durationMs (duration reads seconds, durationMs reads milliseconds).

columnFormats.description: Table kind only. Column name -> { type, decimals?, currency?, datePattern?, unit? }; type is one of number, currency, date, text, duration; unit (duration only) is one of s, ms (default s).

conditionalFormats.description: Metric, table and collection kinds (HEL-1307): null/[] or an ordered list of threshold rules; see the config description above.
